plans.idea: Faithful centered stack like the original: small brand mark on top, bottle, one-line headline with its footnote, then all six pills set as one block at the bottom, everything on a single centre axis.
Two-column split for the wider-than-tall box: brand mark and bottle stacked in a left column, with the headline over the pill block in a right column that shares a common left edge.
Headline-first: a full-width headline band across the top, then the bottle on the left beside the grouped pills on the right, with the brand mark signing off under the pills.
